explanation: A gift from God that gives believers the opportunity to give out of gratitude, not to earn deserved rewards.
God's undeserved favor and goodwill toward people, which is the source of all Christian generosity.
The term used for the gift one gives; what is sown today will yield a rich harvest later through God's blessing.
The spiritual or material restoration and growth that follows when one shares with others, often described as an abundance from God.
A state where all needs are met through God's provision, so that believers may be rich in every good work.
Expressed gratitude and praise given to God when people show willingness to share with others.
